summary: Iteration 12 validated all four requested admin features through the public deployment. Backend: 53/54 regression tests passed; admin user creation as admin, new-user login, duplicate rejection, non-admin 403, password reset/new-vs-old login, short-password 422, fix-log scope/order/shape, role/delete regression, self-protection, bcrypt $2b$ storage, HttpOnly cookie, and lockout all passed. The sole backend failure is credentialed CORS: public preflight returns wildcard origin and no allow-credentials. Desktop UI create/search/reset/delete and Offline Reparatur-Verlauf passed. Mobile Admin > Benutzer has severe horizontal overflow that clips controls. A separate auth identity-conflict defect was reproduced when cookie and Bearer identities differ.

critical.issue: Credentialed CORS fails: preflight returns 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. backend/.env also configures CORS_ORIGINS='*', contrary to the explicit-origin auth requirement.

Authentication identity is ambiguous when both an access_token cookie and Authorization Bearer token are present: the cookie silently wins. Reproduced by sending an admin Bearer token with a normal-user cookie; GET /api/auth/me returned the normal user, and an admin delete request was treated as a self-delete (400).

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px width, user controls overflow horizontally: user-search-input measured 741px wide from x=32, and the table clips role/actions outside the viewport. Search and row actions are not fully usable without horizontal page scrolling.

issues: The non-wrapping admin tab strip and full-width table expand the document beyond the viewport.
Only Name and part of E-Mail are visible; role, mirror count, reset-password, role-toggle, and delete actions are clipped.

action_items: Configure explicit allowed frontend origin(s) at both ingress and FastAPI CORS layers and return Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true for credentialed preflights; do not combine wildcard origin with credentials.
Define one deterministic authentication source. Prefer an explicit valid Bearer header over cookie when supplied, or reject requests where both credentials identify different users.

Make Admin > Benutzer responsive: allow horizontal scrolling inside the table container or use mobile cards, constrain search width, and make the admin tab strip scrollable without expanding the page.
Add API load error handling to AdminDashboard and OfflineStreams so a rejected Promise.all does not leave a permanent loading/blank state.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user reads request.cookies['access_token'] before Authorization, so a stale/different cookie overrides an explicit API token and can downgrade or change the acting identity.

CORS is configured as allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*'; the public ingress currently answers preflight itself with wildcard/no credentials, so browser credentialed cross-origin auth cannot work.
set_auth_cookie uses secure=False even though the public app is HTTPS; production auth cookies should be Secure (with deployment-aware configuration).
AdminDashboard load() and OfflineStreams load() use Promise.all without catch/finally UI state, leaving no recoverable error state if one endpoint fails.
server.py is 1345 lines, well above the 700-line review threshold; split auth, admin users, mirrors/fix logs, host integrations, settings, and background jobs into focused modules.

success_rate.backend: 98.1% (53/54; all requested feature APIs passed, credentialed CORS failed)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested desktop flows passed; mobile Admin Users responsiveness failed)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ admin/user accounts and isolated mirrors during backend/UI tests. All created users and mirrors were deleted; final public API checks confirmed no TEST_ users or mirrors remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 added TestAdminUserManagementAndFixLogs and TestAuthenticationPlaybook. Desktop selectors and flows passed: add-user-button, user-modal, new-user-name/email/role/password, user-modal-submit, user-search-input, reset-pw-{id}, delete-user-{id}, fix-history, fix-log-{id}. Wait for the Offline page's 'Lädt…' state to disappear before asserting history rows. Re-test CORS from the public URL, mismatched cookie/Bearer identity, and the Benutzer tab at 390x844 after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: CORS is misaligned at two layers: FastAPI is configured with wildcard origins while credentials are enabled, and the public ingress intercepts OPTIONS with wildcard/no credential headers. The auth identity conflict is caused by cookie-first credential resolution at server.py lines 64-69. Mobile overflow is caused by wide non-wrapping admin tabs/table content and a table wrapper using overflow-hidden rather than responsive scrolling/cards.
